plugins.name: testing-toolkit
plugins.description: Picks the kind of test a change needs, writes it from the spec, and shows a test only after it has passed, stayed stable over repeated runs, and failed on a planted bug. Covers unit, integration, contract, E2E, characterization, property, fuzz, load, data and LLM-eval tests, plus mutation, audit, flaky-triage and release-safety skills.
